title: Alexander
summary: Raleigh names Alexander in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The Alexander which called himselfe the sonne of Antiochus Epiphanes, who married Cleopatra and made Ptolomais his seat. Not Alexander the Great. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection IV, sig. 221b
